title: Make topic-map builds incremental
description:
## G-9 (from kb-graph-rag-audit)

MaintenanceTopicMapService.BuildAsync is a full-corpus rebuild (_memoryStore.LoadAll() plus every page, re-scanned in full) triggered by weekly schedule or on-demand ?refresh=true. Between rebuilds, cached clusters/cycles/chains/staleness data can be up to a week stale relative to live edits.

### Detailed Steps
1. On each memory/page write (MemoryApplicationService's existing _index.Add/Remove call sites are natural hook points), recompute only the affected node's edges and invalidate/patch the cached TopicMapDocument incrementally rather than requiring a full rebuild
2. Keep existing full-rebuild path as periodic consistency-repair job

### Test Plan
- Editing one record's Tags updates that record's node/edges in cached topic map without a full BuildAsync call, and without disturbing unrelated nodes' cached state

### Source
Audit: `Data/Pages/audits/kb-graph-rag-audit-10-07-26-00-00-00.md` — G-9
- `MaintenanceAgentServices.cs:1493` (RunAsync calling _topicMap.BuildAsync)
- `MaintenanceAgentController.cs:72-88` (TopicMap endpoints with refresh param)
- `MaintenanceTopicMapService.LoadCachedAsync`/`SaveCacheAsync`
